items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: He had a guy named Escudero that played the tuba... This was before the days of the great late John Kirby.

ctx.x: sock cymbal invented the (unintelligible). He's the one that started this.

He had a guy named Escudero that played the tuba, and he was a foreigner, excellent tuba man. This was before the days of the great late John Kirby. And his brass section consisted of a guy that was three-fourths Indian called Big Green from Nebraska, Omaha, Nebraska. I'm telling you these things for a point. And he played trombone. One of the greatest trombonists that I've ever heard play a waltz. Then he had a trumpet player by the name of Elmer Chambers. He had another trumpet player named Scotty. (Howard…
I believe I've heard of him, somewhere along the way.
